keywords.def: (idiom) completely disappeared; vanished into the air

keywords.term: an angel on one shoulder and a devil on the other
keywords.def: (idiom) used to describe a personal dilemma or difficult decision based on an imaginary angel, representing conscience, and an imaginary devil, representing temptation
belief and confidence in your own abilities
secondary effect of a drug or medicine, usually undesirable or unwanted

sentences.en: Hello. This is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 你好。这里是 BBC Learning English 的 6 Minute English。

sentences.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Georgie. Neil, I saw you eating a healthy-looking salad earlier.
sentences.zh: 我是 Neil。我是 Georgie。Neil，我刚才看到你在吃一份看起来很健康的沙拉。

sentences.en: Is there anything else you do to stay healthy?
sentences.zh: 为了保持健康，你还会做些什么吗？

sentences.en: At the moment I am following an exercise routine and I'm eating healthily, but I'm not sure if it's having much effect.
sentences.zh: 目前我正在坚持一套健身计划，而且饮食也很健康，但我不太确定这有没有起到多大作用。

sentences.en: How about you? Uh, well, I'm training for a half marathon at the moment, so I'm doing a lot of running, but I still eat a lot of sugar.
sentences.zh: 你呢？呃，好吧，我目前正在为半程马拉松进行训练，所以我跑了很多步，但我还是吃很多糖。

sentences.en: A sweet treat. Diet, exercise, and eating in moderation helps some people stay at a healthy weight.
sentences.zh: 甜食的诱惑。饮食、运动和适度进食能帮助一些人保持健康的体重。

sentences.en: But with around 65% of British adults estimated to be overweight, that doesn't help everyone.
sentences.zh: 但据估计，大约有 65% 的英国成年人超重，所以这并不能帮到所有人。

sentences.en: But this has changed with the recent invention of weight loss drugs.
sentences.zh: 但随着最近减肥药的发明，这种情况已经发生了改变。

sentences.en: Yes. Weight loss drugs like Ozempic and Mounjaro have been a hot topic this year.
sentences.zh: 是的。像 Ozempic 和 Mounjaro 这样的减肥药是今年的热门话题。

sentences.en: The drugs are modified versions of natural hormones which make us feel full when released into the body.
sentences.zh: 这些药物是天然激素的改良版本，天然激素在释放到体内时会让我们产生饱腹感。

sentences.en: Weight loss drugs are injected into the tummy and replicate this effect, but last much longer.
sentences.zh: 减肥药被注射到腹部，并复制这种效果，但持续时间要长得多。

sentences.en: The idea is that you feel full for longer, eat less, and lose weight.
sentences.zh: 其原理是让你更长时间地感到饱腹，从而吃得更少，达到减肥的效果。

sentences.en: In this episode, we'll be hearing more about these drugs helping people lose weight, and as usual, we'll be learning some useful new words and phrases.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将听到更多关于这些药物帮助人们减肥的内容，和往常一样，我们还将学习一些实用的新单词和短语。

sentences.en: Plus, there's a worksheet and quiz to practise all the vocabulary we'll learn on our website.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的网站上还提供了工作纸和测验，供大家练习我们将学到的所有词汇。

sentences.en: But first I have a question for you, Neil.
sentences.zh: 但首先，我有一个问题要问你，Neil。

sentences.en: The measurement used by doctors to estimate if someone is at a healthy weight is called BMI.
sentences.zh: 医生用来评估某人体重是否健康的指标叫做 BMI。

sentences.en: But what does BMI stand for? Is it: a) British medical index? b) Body mass index? or, c) Body muscle index?
sentences.zh: 但 BMI 代表什么？是：a) 英国医学指数？b) 身体质量指数？还是 c) 身体肌肉指数？

sentences.en: Well, I am 99.9% certain that I know the answer, Georgie, so I don't want to spoil it for our listeners, so we'll just find out at the end.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我 99.9% 确定我知道答案，Georgie，所以我不想给我们的听众剧透，我们就在最后再揭晓答案吧。

sentences.en: OK then. For radio listener Lynne Massey-Davis, weight loss drugs have been life-changing.
sentences.zh: 那好吧。对于电台听众 Lynne Massey-Davis 来说，减肥药改变了她的生活。

sentences.en: Using the drug Mounjaro, Lynne lost 20kg in six months, and now feels happier than ever about her weight, something she discussed with Greg Foot, presenter of BBC Radio 4 programme, Sliced Bread.
sentences.zh: 通过使用药物 Mounjaro，Lynne 在六个月内减掉了 20 公斤，现在对自己的体重感到前所未有的满意，她与 BBC Radio 4 节目 Sliced Bread 的主持人 Greg Foot 探讨了这件事。

sentences.en: What's it like to be on it? Well, I don't get hungry, so food noise stops.
sentences.zh: 服用这种药是什么感觉？嗯，我不会感到饿，所以“食物杂音”停止了。

sentences.en: And all those scripts about yourself - that you're a bad person for eating.
sentences.zh: 还有所有那些关于你自己的潜台词——比如因为吃东西而觉得自己是个坏人。

sentences.en: I feel like that judgment has drifted into the ether.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那种审判已经消失在九霄云外了。

sentences.en: And when you say food noise, what do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你说的“食物杂音”是什么意思？

sentences.en: For me, it was a conflict, like I'd got a devil and an angel on my shoulders.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这是一种冲突，就像我的肩膀上坐着一个恶魔和一个天使。

sentences.en: The angel said, 'Don't eat that because you shouldn't eat food!' The devil inside me said, 'Oh, but you just want a taste!' It damaged my self-esteem for a very, very long time, probably for the best part of maybe 50 years.
sentences.zh: 天使说：‘别吃那个，因为你不应该吃东西！’我内心的恶魔却说：‘哦，但你只是想尝尝味道！’这在非常非常长的一段时间里伤害了我的自尊心，可能长达将近 50 年。

sentences.en: Weight loss drugs help Lynne reduce food noise, a term for intrusive and unwanted thoughts about food.
sentences.zh: 减肥药帮助 Lynne 减少了“食物杂音”，这个词指的是关于食物的侵入性和不想要的念头。

sentences.en: In fact, Lynne says her unwanted food noise has gone into the ether, meaning it has completely disappeared.
sentences.zh: 事实上，Lynne 说她那些不想要的食物杂音已经“消失在九霄云外”，意思是它已经完全消失了。

sentences.en: Before using Mounjaro, Lynne felt conflicted about food.
sentences.zh: 在使用 Mounjaro 之前，Lynne 对食物感到很纠结。

sentences.en: She says there was an angel on one shoulder and a devil on the other, an old idiom which describes having a personal dilemma.
sentences.zh: 她说自己“肩膀上一边是天使，另一边是恶魔”，这是一个古老的习语，用来形容陷入个人抉择的困境。

sentences.en: An imaginary angel, representing Lynne's conscience, told her what she should do, while a devil sat on the other shoulder, whispering temptations in her ear.
sentences.zh: 一个虚构的天使代表着 Lynne 的良知，告诉她应该做什么，而恶魔坐在另一边肩膀上，在她耳边低语着诱惑。

sentences.en: Over many years, this inner conflict damaged Lynn's self-esteem, her belief and confidence in her own abilities.
sentences.zh: 多年来，这种内心冲突伤害了 Lynn 的自尊心，即她对自身能力的信念和信心。

sentences.en: Interestingly, weight loss drugs weren't invented to lose weight at all.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，减肥药最初根本不是为了减肥而发明的。

sentences.en: They were originally designed for diabetes, a disease caused when someone's blood sugar levels get too high.
sentences.zh: 它们最初是为糖尿病设计的，这是一种由于血糖水平过高而引起的疾病。

sentences.en: It was only later that doctors noticed the drugs' effect on weight.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，医生才注意到这些药物对体重的影响。

sentences.en: Professor Giles Yeo researches obesity and is also a consultant for companies developing weight loss drugs.
sentences.zh: Professor Giles Yeo 从事肥胖症研究，同时也是开发减肥药公司的顾问。

sentences.en: Here he is talking to BBC Radio 4's Sliced Bread.
sentences.zh: 这是他在接受 BBC Radio 4 的 Sliced Bread 节目采访。

sentences.en: We talk about Ozempic first because that was the first on the market for diabetes, and then people begin to notice, as a side effect, that people were losing weight.
sentences.zh: 我们先来谈谈 Ozempic，因为它是第一款上市治疗糖尿病的药物，然后人们开始注意到，作为一种副作用，患者的体重减轻了。

sentences.en: A lot of people with diabetes also haveobesity and part of the effects of actually reversing the diabetes is the fact that they lose weight and so doctors began to sort of prescribe them off-label.
sentences.zh: 许多糖尿病患者也患有肥胖症，而实际逆转糖尿病的部分效果就在于他们减轻了体重，因此医生开始有些“超说明书”地开这些药。

sentences.en: Ozempic was the first drug on the market.
sentences.zh: Ozempic 是市场上第一款此类药物。

sentences.en: When something is on the market, it's available for sale.
sentences.zh: 当某样东西“在市场上”时，意思就是它可以出售。

sentences.en: Ozempic was designed for diabetes, but doctors noticed that patients lost weight as a side effect.
sentences.zh: Ozempic 是为糖尿病设计的，但医生注意到患者体重减轻是其副作用。

sentences.en: A side effect is an unexpected secondary effect of a drug or medicine.
sentences.zh: 副作用是指药物或医学治疗中意想不到的次要作用。

sentences.en: It's usually an undesirable effect, although not in this case as it helped people lose weight.
sentences.zh: 它通常是不良反应，尽管在这种情况下并非如此，因为它帮助人们减轻了体重。

sentences.en: But could weight loss drugs be too good to be true?
sentences.zh: 但是，减肥药会不会好得令人难以置信？

sentences.en: A public health official in the UK warns that the drugs alone are not the solution and that people should be encouraged to have a healthier lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 英国的一位公共卫生官员警告说，单靠药物并不是解决办法，应该鼓励人们拥有更健康的生活方式。

sentences.en: Right, Georgie, isn't it time you revealed the answer to your question?
sentences.zh: 对了，Georgie，是不是该揭晓你那个问题的答案了？

sentences.en: Yes. I asked about BMI, which is the measurement used by doctors to estimate if someone is at a healthy weight.
sentences.zh: 是的。我问了关于 BMI 的问题，这是医生用来评估某人体重是否健康的指标。

sentences.en: But what does BMI stand for? Now Neil, you didn't give me an answer earlier.
sentences.zh: 但 BMI 代表什么？Neil，你刚才没有给我答案。

sentences.en: Yes, that's because I was sure the answer is b) body mass index.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是因为我确信答案是 b) 身体质量指数。

sentences.en: That's correct, well done. OK, let's recap the vocabulary we've learned, starting with food noise, intrusive and unwanted thoughts about food.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，做得好。好了，让我们复习一下学到的词汇，首先是“食物杂音”，指关于食物的侵入性和不想要的念头。

sentences.en: The idiom, an angel on one shoulder and a devil on the other describes a personal dilemma where someone must choose whether to follow their conscience or not.
sentences.zh: 习语“肩膀上一边是天使，另一边是恶魔”描述了一种个人抉择的困境，即人们必须选择是否听从自己的良知。

sentences.en: Self-esteem means a belief in your own abilities and value.
sentences.zh: 自尊是指对自身能力和价值的信念。

sentences.en: If something disappears into the ether, it completely goes away.
sentences.zh: 如果某样东西“消失在九霄云外”，它就完全消失了。

sentences.en: It vanishes into the air. A product which is on the market is available for people to buy.
sentences.zh: 它消散在空气中。一个“在市场上”的产品是指人们可以购买到的产品。

sentences.en: And finally, a side effect is an unexpected, and usually unwanted, secondary effect of a drug or medicine.
sentences.zh: 最后，副作用是指药物或医学治疗中意想不到的、通常是不良的次要作用。

sentences.en: Once again, our six minutes are up. But if you're interested in programmes about health, we have a health topic page which you can find on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 我们的六分钟时间又到了。但如果你对健康方面的节目感兴趣，我们在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上有一个健康主题页面。

sentences.en: See you there soon! Goodbye!
sentences.zh: 我们那儿见！再见！
